title: Leave requests from your staff, approved and answered on their phone
summary: Staff ask for leave with a form; a manager approves; they hear the answer on WhatsApp, Telegram or by text.
description: Your staff ask for leave with a short form: their name, phone number, the type of leave, the dates and why. Their phone is checked with a code, the request is saved in your leave table in Taskiem (columns: reference, name, phone, leave_type, start_date, end_date, reason, status), and the manager (or the role you choose) approves or declines it in Taskiem, WhatsApp or Telegram. The row is updated, and the staff member is told the decision on the WhatsApp or Telegram they chose on the form's thank-you page with one tap, or by text message. Your staff do not need a Taskiem account, and nobody is asked for a chat ID. Make the leave table under Tables first, or let Taskiem make it when you accept the workflow.

params.name: table
params.title: Leave table
params.description: Your table with reference, name, phone, leave_type, start_date, end_date, reason and status columns.

params.name: approver_role
params.title: Who approves
params.description: The role that approves leave, such as manager.

definition.name: Leave requests
definition.description: Saves each leave request, gets it approved and tells the staff member.

after.message: Thank you. Your manager will look at your request, and you will hear the answer on your phone.

steps.name: Save the request in the leave table
Record the decision in the leave table
Tell the staff member the decision

input.title: Leave request
input.message: =steps.decide.output.decision == 'approved' ? 'Your ' + trigger.body.leave_type + ' leave from ' + trigger.body.start_date + ' to ' + trigger.body.end_date + ' is approved. Reference ' + trigger.form.reference + '.' : 'Your ' + trigger.body.leave_type + ' leave from ' + trigger.body.start_date + ' to ' + trigger.body.end_date + ' was not approved. Please speak to your manager.'
